We need to produce JSON refining the initial plan. Initial plan: add leakage-safe smoothed target-encoding features for coupon-context keys. Modules: data_processing_and_feature_engineering (FeatureEngineer, target encoders, OOF fitting, persistence), and training_evaluation (fold-safe fitting of encoders, artifacts saving/loading, inner K-fold). Possibly model_design not needed since base architectures unchanged. Historical experiments: CatBoost ordered target statistics worked; also successful experiment of stateful FeatureEngineer fit per fold and persisted; blend+threshold search. Consistent with initial plan: keep architectures unchanged, so only two modules.

Let me write reason and plan for both modules with details: smoothing strength ~20, keys coupon, occupation, coupon×occupation, coupon×time, coupon×expiration, coupon×distance_bucket, coupon×direction_same; fit only on training fold; inner K-fold for final; persistence.

Log-odds vs probability encoding: use smoothed posterior probability then optionally logit transform; keep prior. Compatibility: FeatureEngineer.fit signature extended to accept optional y and fold scheme; transform unchanged, feature_columns ordering must include new columns; persisted via pickle of fe object plus explicit prior/mappings for reload robustness (predict path uses fe.transform so mappings must be attributes). Mention ClippedOOF handling: inner K-fold with 5 folds, seed 42; fallback to prior when count 0. Caps: keep runtime under 600s — encoding is cheap.

Interface constraints: FeatureEngineer.fit(df) currently called as FeatureEngineer().fit(df) in run_oof, final_fit; must update calls to fit(df, y=y_tr) with default y=None preserving backward compat. build_cat_block_spec uses fe.nominal_categories — unchanged. Transformation must reindex to feature_columns.

Also training_evaluation: change run_oof to fit encoder inside fold (already fits FE per fold), add y to fit; add inner-K-fold for final_fit; persist smoothing params; ensure prediction loads encodings from pickled fe (no refit).

Write JSON.
